scope: 常见网络口语、表情反应、搭子社交、围观追更和视频互动短词；固定 6000 类别档。
author: root
review_scope: Single AI author reads every selected word and default key in context, then records positional polyphone decisions. Structural reconstruction is a separate code path, not an independent linguistic editor. Individually authored natural vocabulary, no copied corpus sentences or private text.
pronunciation_dependency: pypinyin0.55.0 authoring-only; default agreement is not a review decision
frequency_policy: Fixed coarse project-relative category bands before native evaluation; no measured corpus frequencies or tuning to public answer ranks.
